name: EPIC 220671160
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.2 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220671160 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.21095 (16th-84th percentiles 8.847996-9.659735), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220671160: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4720.2935 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220671160 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2668.203125 (16th-84th percentiles 2582.65625-2767.226562), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.27 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,668 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.05 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,720 K at its surface.
